Description: Unique identifier assigned to each participant (original session labels remapped to integers 1-1015).
Data collection site (one of 14 universities: Arizona, Bristol, Colby, MARCS, Macquarie, Melbourne, Nebraska, Plymouth, RHUL, Singapore, Skidmore, UWO, WUSTL, Warwick).
Presentation order within the session (1-840). The 28 practice trials that preceded these are not distributed, so the source trial numbers 29-868 are renumbered from 1.
The target letter string presented in upper case for the lexical decision.
The prime shown in lower case for 50 ms immediately before the target, after a forward mask.
Prime type abbreviation (28 levels), e.g. ID = identity, SN-M = medial substitution, ALD-ARB = unrelated arbitrary. See README.md for the full list.

Positional code describing how the prime was derived from the target relative to 123456, e.g. 123d56 = a random letter substituted at position 4. 'd' denotes a random letter not present in the target.
Type of the target: word or nonword.

The participant's decision (word or nonword). Empty when the response deadline elapsed without a response. The source data records only accuracy, so the response is recovered from accuracy and stimulus_type; the task had exactly two alternatives.
Binary indicator of whether the participant's response was correct.
Time taken by the participant to respond, in milliseconds. For timeouts this is the 2000 ms deadline.
Binary indicator of whether the 2000 ms response deadline elapsed without a response.
Participant's proportion correct on the 40-item Shipley (1940) vocabulary test administered after the main task. Empty where not recorded.
Participant's proportion correct on the 82-item spelling lexical decision block administered after the main task. Empty where not recorded.
